title: I Finally Read "Attention Is All You Need" — The Paper That Changed Everything
subtitle: It was published in 2017. It's 2026 now. And somehow, reading it still feels like watching someone hand someone else fire.

title: Foundation Models: The Ground Everything Is Being Built On (and Why It Had Better Not Crack)
subtitle: I read Stanford's giant report on foundation models. It's part tech roadmap, part warning label, and it left me with one nagging question: who's actually going to pay for the good stuff?

title: IQuest-Q1: The Open Model That Did Every Stage of Training (and Then Helped Build Its Own Successor)
subtitle: A brand-new open-weight agent model that doesn't just polish the last step. It shows its work from pre-training to RL, measures how far it could safely scale, and even helps debug its own training data.
